name: Old North State Water Company

documented_policy.payment_fee_documentation: FAQ: payments through the online account include a processing fee. No amount is published on onswc.com (checked 2026-10-05 and 2026-10-11); the amounts below are synthetic construction values.
documented_policy.autopay_timing_documentation: Rates page: bills are due on the billing date and past due 15 days after it. Portal AutoPay drafting on the due date (0 days before) is a synthetic rule.

ach_draft.documentation: FAQ lists 'ACH Auto Draft by calling Customer Service' as a payment option. The shared Starnik client (captured ACHPage bundle) provides the online ACH page; its availability for this community is a synthetic assumption.
ach_draft.agreement_text: I authorize Old North State Water Company to initiate recurring ACH debits from the bank account entered above for the full amount of each monthly water and wastewater bill on its billing date, until I deactivate ACH in the portal or by calling Customer Service at 877-511-2911. (Synthetic local agreement text; the original agreement is served privately.)
ach_draft.autopay_warning: This account is also enrolled in online AutoPay. Keeping both ACH Auto Draft and AutoPay active can draft the same bill twice. Disable AutoPay if ACH Auto Draft should be your only automatic payment. (Synthetic local wording; the original warning message is served privately.)
